data_manifest.license: Apache-2.0; dataset card specifies scientific/research use

source_statistics.quantile_method: Exact empirical inverse CDF on all listen timestamps, ceil(q*N) rank
source_statistics.timestamp_unit: Relative seconds rounded down to multiples of 5; multiply by neither 5 nor Unix epoch

data_manifest.reward_rule: clip(played_ratio_pct/100,0,1); replay beyond 100 retained separately as played_ratio_raw
data_manifest.target_rule: Only recommendation-driven listens (is_organic=0); all strictly earlier listens, including organic, form context.
data_manifest.history_rule: Last 48 listens strictly before target timestamp; contemporaneous listens share one prefix; repeated consumed items remain eligible.
data_manifest.return7_label_rule: Activity on a strictly later relative day within 604800 seconds; training window must mature before train cutoff; evaluation window before dataset end.
data_manifest.duration_rule: Candidate metadata uses median duration from cohort train listens only; row duration is observed track length for diagnostics, never future fitted metadata.
data_manifest.sampling_rule: Uniform without replacement per user and period: <= 100 train targets, <= 20 evaluation targets, selected independently of reward. User-macro means target the per-user event distribution; sampling_weight retained for weighted micro analyses.
data_manifest.catalog_rule: Most frequent items in all cohort train listens; UNK targets retained as misses; previously consumed music is allowed.
data_manifest.feedback_rule: Explicit like/dislike/unlike/undislike events are excluded from item histories and targets; their number is reported in source statistics.

artist_metadata.selection_rule: Top <=64 artists by summed full-cohort train listen counts of mapped in-vocabulary tracks; ties artist ID; multi-artist tracks credit every associated artist.
artist_metadata.feature_rule: Individual features for selected artists; artist_other for all remaining or missing associations. Full sorted artist_ids retained separately.
artist_metadata.static_metadata_assumption: Artist-track relations treated as static; no historical metadata snapshots. Only train-observed catalogue items and training counts determine selected features.
artist_metadata.primary_id_rule: artist_id is the smallest associated numeric ID for convenience, not an asserted primary performer.

sft_selection.criterion: RM-validation user-macro NDCG@10; first prespecified seed only

selection.rule: Maximise user-macro observed-completion weighted hit among recipes with mean validation NDCG >=95% baseline. Same recipe for all seeds; baseline always eligible.
selection.heldout_use: Primary and confirmation predictions not inspected before this file was written.
